description: Get a company's INTERNAL level names for a job family, ordered by seniority (e.g. Google L3/L4/L5, Meta E3/E4/E5, Stripe IC1/IC2/IC3), with any alternate names per level. Use this FIRST when a question names a specific level at a specific company (e.g. "what does a Meta E5 make"), then call get-salaries-by-company-level. Returns an empty list with an explanation when the company has no known level structure. Free limit: Full level data for Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Meta and Apple. Other companies: level names only. Pass canonical slugs (jobFamilySlug, locationSlug, countrySlug, companySlug): resolve names first with search-job-families, search-locations and search-companies; never guess a slug. REQUIRED arguments: companySlug, jobFamilySlug.

companySlug.description: The company (slug) whose internal level structure to list, e.g. "google", "meta", "stripe". Resolve a company name to its slug via search-companies first.

jobFamilySlug.description: A Levels.fyi job family slug, e.g. "software-engineer", "product-manager", "data-scientist".

name: get-company-levels
